scope: Original positive rational Bezier UV boundaries, degree 1..32, with exact supporting-line separation
proof: Each curve must already have an injectivity proof
Exact orientations of original controls bound closed supporting half-planes
At least one strict Bernstein coefficient puts the entire open curve strictly on one side
The other nonshared endpoint must lie on the strict side or outside the other control hull
Two-curve loops may share both independently owned endpoints
budget: Every orientation consumes one cell with at most 256 predicate work units; the existing global cell limit is retained
limitations: This proves UV loop simplicity for sufficient supporting-line cases, not general NURBS self-intersection completeness
No fillet radius, wall thickness or embedded body is implied
